ModMetaData.name: No Steam Popup
ModMetaData.author: CryptikLemur
ModMetaData.description:
Drops the "Could not initialize Steam API" dialog that RimWorld shows on the main menu when no Steam client is reachable.
Built for gamecrate containers, where there is never a Steam client and the dialog is only ever in the way. No dependencies: it sets one private field by reflection.
That field is what every Steam call checks, so the whole game now believes Steam started. In a container nothing reachable cares. On a desktop with Steam already running the field is true anyway and this changes nothing. The one case to know about is a desktop with Steam missing: opening the in-game Workshop screen would attempt Steam calls instead of greying out.
